body.name: Haze Blade
body.description: In a late-night escapade, a tipsy wizard and an equally sloshed blacksmith clumsily combined their crafts, spilling enchanted ale on a blade mid-forging. The result was this bewitched sword, leaving foes as befuddled and dazed as its creators on that fateful evening.
body.effect: Hitting a target inflicts a 3 seconds drunken state.
